name: qwen36_27b_fv_gspo_asi2
description: Frontier-Verifier GSPO (FV-GSPO) training for Qwen3.6-27B on ASI2. Trains GRPO only on learnable frontier groups with mixed outcomes; routes all-fail tasks into an execution-verified repair queue (sidecar: scripts/fv_gspo_repair_sidecar.sh keeps conversions flowing so the all_fail_without_repair breaker never false-trips); uses leave-one-out advantages without per-task std normalization; applies GSPO sequence-level clipping (0.1/0.2 — recalibrated 2026-08-20 from 3e-4/4e-4 which pinned the policy and produced inert adapters); mixes 50% targeted / 25% neighboring / 25% replay; teacher-free self-repair (2 rounds) converts failing candidates into positive signal; held-out eval tasks are strictly outside training; executable tests are authoritative (self-judge reward weight 0); circuit breakers on regression, entropy, clipping, frontier yield, and repair conversion. See docs/frontier-verifier-gspo-design-2026-08-04.md.

self_evaluation.note: current-adapter self-judgment starts with zero reward weight; enable only after executable-label calibration (cap 0.05, subtracted from shaped terms, never from pass reward)

held_out.note: held-out eval tasks are strictly outside training: never prompts, targets, tests, or paraphrases

preflight_gates: repo code synced to remote root
torch, torch_npu, transformers, peft, and accelerate import or the run is blocked
short probe shows healthy frontier yield before a long run
